prompt: ___ veo todos los días. (I see him every day.)
I give him the book. → ___ doy el libro.
hint: Le is the indirect object pronoun for él/ella.

prompt: ___ mando ahora. (I'm sending it to him now.) [lo + le combined]
hint: Le + lo → Se lo. Indirect comes first, then direct.

prompt: Can you give it to me? → ¿___ puedes dar?

hint: Attach the direct object pronoun to the affirmative command.
